why: Columns decided in issue #551 (CP-27 decisions: the frontend's data gaps, 0 new tables) that the migrations do not have yet. Nothing is built. The names are the orchestrator's proposals and the builder of the CP-27 group named in #551 confirms each against the code, so a wireframe may bind to one (check.mjs prints a note, not an error) and the name may still change. When a column is built it is deleted from this file in the same commit; the migrations then carry it and check.mjs holds the wireframe to them.
